freshness.title: From 4:00 AM Coastal Docks to Your Doorstep
freshness.subtitle: Real seafood flavor is born from uncompromising freshness. We rely on thermal physics, never chemicals.
freshness.step1Desc: No middlemen. Our certified scouts inspect lots directly as boats dock at Ratnagiri and Malvan at dawn.
freshness.step2Desc: Fish are immersed in sub-zero liquid slurry within minutes, locking in cellular structure and pristine ocean scent.
freshness.step3Desc: We conduct daily digital testing. Zero formalin, zero ammonia, and zero chemical preservatives — guaranteed.
freshness.step4Desc: Prepared in our Karad facility on sanitized stainless-steel benches, washed in purified RO water, and packed in food-grade insulated trays.

familyStory.title: Selected Like Shopping for Family
familyStory.quote: Buying fish in Karad is no longer a gamble at an overcrowded market; it is an intimate bond of family trust.
familyStory.storyP1: AN Fish World was born with a single heartfelt mission: ensuring every household in Karad has access to the exact same uncompromising freshness enjoyed right by the Arabian sea coast.
familyStory.storyP2: We treat every customer not as a transaction, but as family. Just as a mother or grandmother inspects every gill and scale with affectionate scrutiny, our master fishmongers curate only what we would proudly feed our own children. That is why our catch is affectionately called 'Laadki' (beloved) by Karad's homes.
familyStory.signature: — The AN Fish World Family, Karad

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How do you guarantee authentic freshness?
faq.a1: Our catch arrives daily from coastal auctions at Ratnagiri and Malvan. Gills are vivid ruby, eyes are convex and translucent, and flesh springs back instantly when pressed. There is only the crisp, clean scent of the sea.
faq.q2: What is the delivery time within Karad?
faq.a2: Once your order is confirmed, custom butchering takes under 15 minutes and delivery reaches your doorstep within [FILL: 45 MINS IN KARAD] in insulated ice-chilled packaging.
faq.q3: How is the fish cleaned and dressed?
faq.a3: Every fish is completely descaled, degutted, and washed in purified RO water on sanitized surgical stainless-steel tables. You receive zero waste and 100% kitchen-ready meat.
faq.q4: How do daily market rates work?
faq.a4: Because we only source wild and fresh daily catches, prices align with the daily dock auction rates announced every morning at 7:00 AM. Reach us on WhatsApp or phone for today's live rate card.
